text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary p99 latency spike on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Error rate up ~12% (5xx/timeouts). Trigger: latency threshold breached for 3 consecutive minutes.

sam: ack — I'm the oncall. pulling up graphs and traces now.

priya: seeing a big tail on p95->p99 for the canary hostpool (canary-3). traces show many requests stuck in proxy layer ~10s then timeout.

devon: adding to thread. i'm seeing elevated downstream connection resets from the multiplexer (grpc-proxy) for that pool. keepalive spikes too.

maria: any known customer-impacting alerts? CX dashboard shows increased failures for a small % of customers hitting long requests, some timeouts appear as 504 from gateway.

sam: customer-impact estimate: ~3% of production traffic routed to canary, so global impact ~0.36% of requests failing — small but we should roll back the canary quickly.

priya: digging into canary config delta vs stable — only change was small pooling tweak: MAX_CONNS_PER_BACKEND lowered and a different connection reuse flag turned on. suspect connection saturation.

devon: running live query on proxy metrics:```\n# prometheus query\nsum(rate(grpc_stream_resets_total{pool="canary-3"}[1m])) by (instance)\n``` returns a spike on canary-3 instance i-08f.

sam: ok, plan: 1) stop routing new traffic to canary, 2) rollback canary to previous image, 3) monitor for p99 drop and error rate normalization. any objections?

priya: agree. I'll flip routing. Sam, can you trigger rollback if routing flip doesn't bring it down in 2 mins?

sam: flipping routing now — reducing canary weight to 0%.

ops-bot: [ORCH] Route update applied: canary weight for /v1/generate set to 0% (was 10%).

priya: immediate improvement in p95 within 30s. p99 still elevated on existing in-flight requests but error rate trending down.

devon: still seeing some hung connections lingering, but new connections are fine. Might need to evict the problematic backend instance.

maria: product note: no major customer tickets yet; support rate unchanged. keep us posted.

sam: giving it 90s. If p99 doesn't get below threshold, i'll initiate rollback.

priya: p99 is at 1.2s down from 3.8s — good trend. but we have a handful of 504s from the gateway.

sam: we should still roll back the canary build to be safe — low risk and quick. initiating rollback now.

deploy-bot: rollback requested by sam for service inference-api: reverting canary tag 'canary-20260315-b5' -> 'stable-20260312-a2'. ETA ~45s.

devon: also recommending a forced connection drain on instance i-08f to clear stuck multiplexed streams.

priya: running drain command:```\n# admin api\nPOST https://admin.internal/services/inference-api/instances/i-08f/drain\nAuthorization: Bearer <token>\n```\nresponse: 202 Accepted.

ops-bot: drain initiated on i-08f. active streams will be allowed to finish with 60s grace. new connections blocked.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. current revision: stable-20260312-a2.

sam: monitoring post-rollback metrics. p99 back to baseline ~220ms, error rate down to normal. marking incident mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:

priya: root cause hypothesis: pooling change reduced max connections but enabled aggressive reuse that caused head-of-line blocking on grpc-proxy when a backend started stalling — led to connection starvation and timeouts. we'll run a canary test against a synthetic workload before re-rolling the change.

devon: I'll follow up with a postmortem section: include traces, instance i-08f logs, proxy keepalive breakdown, and the diff of pooling flags. planning to reproduce in staging with high-concurrency synthetic traffic.

maria: can you include customer impact estimate and timeline so we can notify accounts if needed?

sam: yes — approximate impact window: 6219876543 -> 6219876590 (47s of elevated 5xx), scope ~0.36% of requests saw increased latency/errors; no large account outages reported.

priya: adding follow-up actions: 1) add canary gating that runs synthetic concurrency test, 2) revert pooling change on staging and try incremental increments, 3) add alert for grpc_stream_reset rate per instance.

devon: assigning owners: priya -> fix + canary harness, devon -> repro + instance log analysis, sam -> customer comms if needed.

sam: handing off to night oncall @nate in 30m. nate — can you watch the /v1/generate p99 for next 2 hours? escalate if p99 > 1s or 5xx > 1%.

nate: ack — i'll take watch. thanks for the handoff. :eyes:

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Alert for Canary p99 latency spike cleared. Escalation closed by sam.

sam: closing thread — will add postmortem doc link once devon/priya have initial notes. thanks all. :tada:
